name: Muju
description:
Muju connects people with local businesses through a conversational AI experience.

Users can discover nearby restaurants, explore local offerings, ask questions, receive recommendations, and complete actions such as placing pickup orders with participating businesses.

Muju helps local businesses make their products and services easier to discover by connecting their existing information, menus, and ordering systems to AI.

Our mission is to create a local connection layer where communities can easily find and support businesses around them.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Muju to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Muju to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mujucommunity.com/mcp/MU_MUJU_UJJ.

_published_faq.name: Is Muju MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Muju scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Muju MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Muju provides these MCP tools: get_order_status, get_restaurant_menu, get_restaurants, and submit_mcp_order.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Muju?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Muju in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator, and Evaneos.
Muju does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Muju is developed by Chula Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
